Name: CP - SH's Trash Cats - Cat Replacers
Author: plurffle
Description:
[center][/center][left][img]https://imgur.com/i0qbWzk.png[/img]
Someone requested I convert some of my animals from my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9063]Wild Animals mod[/url]﻿ into pets.  ᓚᘏᗢ⋆˙⟡[/left]
This mod features sprites from my Wild Animals mod as pets, sprites for the UI section, and a config file that allows you to pick which animal replaces which cat of your choice (including an option to simply disable the change)! :D


[img]https://imgur.com/bBYKTj4.png[/img]
[b][size=3]Q: [/size]How to install this mod?[/b]
[b][size=3]A: [/size][/b]Unzip the zip file and place the "[CP] SH's Trash Cats - Cat Replacers" folder in your Mods folder.

[b][size=3]Q: [/size]Is this mod compatible with mobile/multiplayer?[/b]
[size=3][b]A: [/b][/size]I do not have the mobile version of the game, but I assume it should be work just fine in there since this is a Content Patcher mod. This should definitely work in multiplayer!

[b][size=3]Q: [/size]Is there going to be an [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url] version of this mod?[/b]
[size=3][b]A: [/b][/size]You can get that here: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16797/]AT - SH's Trash Cats - Cat Replacers[/url]

[b]Q: Is there a version of this mod that doesn't replace the existing pet textures?[/b]
[b]A: [/b]Yes, actually! >w< It's called "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23885]SH's More Adoptable Animals (More Custom Pets)[/url]" and you can find that mod in my profile. Big thing to note is that adding new pets to the game was a feature added in the game's 1.6 update, therefore that mod will not work for any versions prior. The CP and AT version will work fine with 1.5 game version.



I just created a Ko-fi! If you like my works, then feel free to [url=https://ko-fi.com/smolhooman_plurffle]buy me a coffee[/url]﻿~! I'll greatly appreciate the support! <3 However, my mods will always stay free for the public!
